- Added `JobDeleteManyParams.Where`, an escape hatch for deleting jobs by an arbitrary SQL predicate, like `JobListParams.Where` does for lists. For example, it can select queued jobs whose args name a given customer. A `Where` predicate counts as a filter, so it doesn't need `UnsafeAll`, and each predicate is wrapped in parentheses so that an `OR` in it can't widen the deletion past other filters or to running jobs. ### Added

- Add `river migrate-get` for offline Postgres/SQLite SQL export with version selection, exclusions, and schema substitution; `river validate` to check migration state without applying changes; and `river version` / `river --version` to report active core, Pro, and Ruby runtime versions. Export and validation support `--line pro`. [PR #1560](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1560).

- Fixed SQLite metadata updates recursively merging nested objects and deleting keys set to JSON null. Updates now replace whole top-level values, matching Postgres and preventing completed resumable cursor steps from running again on later retries. [PR #1533](https://github.com/riverqueue/river/pull/1533).
